questions.q: The finance department will review the ___ before the board meeting on Thursday.
questions.note: 冠詞 the 後面要名詞。★ 四個選項是同一字的變化 = 詞性題，直接看空格前後：the ___ before，中間只能放名詞。

questions.q: Ms. Okafor handled the client complaint ___ and the issue was resolved the same day.
questions.note: 修飾動詞 handled 要用副詞。★ 空格後面接 and 表示句子已完整，能被拿掉的多半是副詞。

questions.q: All visitors must present a ___ form of identification at the security desk.
questions.note: 名詞 form 前面要形容詞。★ 冠詞 a 與名詞之間的空格，九成是形容詞。

questions.q: The recent ___ in shipping costs has affected our quarterly margins.
questions.note: The recent ___ in 是「冠詞＋形容詞＋名詞」的結構。★ recent 是形容詞，形容詞後面只能接名詞。

questions.q: Employees are encouraged to make ___ about improving workplace safety.
questions.note: make 的受詞要名詞。★ make suggestions 是固定搭配，跟 make a decision、make an appointment 同一組。

questions.q: The new filing system has made document retrieval considerably ___.
questions.note: considerably 是副詞，後面要修飾形容詞。★ make + 受詞 + 形容詞（使…變得…）。

questions.q: Please contact the help desk if you experience any ___ logging into the portal.
questions.note: any 後面要名詞。★ difficulty 在這裡是不可數名詞，指「困難、麻煩」。

questions.q: The training session was ___ organized, and every participant received the materials on time.
questions.note: 修飾過去分詞 organized 要副詞。★ be 動詞後面看到 -ed，空格在中間，答案幾乎都是副詞。

questions.q: Mr. Delgado gave a brief ___ of the merger during the staff assembly.
questions.note: a brief ___ of 是「冠詞＋形容詞＋名詞」。★ 空格後有 of，前面通常是名詞。

questions.q: The consultant found the survey results particularly ___.
questions.note: found + 受詞 + 形容詞（覺得…是…）。★ particularly 是副詞，修飾的是後面的形容詞。

questions.q: Attendance at the annual compliance workshop is ___ for all department heads.
questions.note: be 動詞後面接形容詞當主詞補語。★ is ___ for 這個結構，空格是形容詞。

questions.q: The company announced its ___ to open three new branches in the region.
questions.note: 所有格 its 後面要名詞。★ its／my／their 後面的空格一律是名詞。

questions.q: Our supplier responded ___ to the urgent request for replacement parts.
questions.note: 修飾動詞 responded 要副詞。★ 不及物動詞後面的空格，若句子已完整，答案是副詞。

questions.q: The revised contract includes several ___ to the delivery schedule.
questions.note: several 後面要複數名詞。★ several、many、few 這類數量詞後面一定是名詞。

questions.q: Sales figures for the second quarter were ___ higher than the forecast.
questions.note: 修飾比較級 higher 要副詞。★ 形容詞或比較級前面的空格，答案是副詞。

questions.q: By the time the auditors arrive next Monday, the finance team ___ all the required documents.
questions.note: By the time + 未來時間點 → 主句用未來完成式。★ 看到 By the time 加未來時間，直接找 will have + 過去分詞。

questions.q: Ms. Tanaka ___ for the company for over fifteen years before she was promoted to director.
questions.note: before 後面是過去式 → 前面那件事更早，用過去完成式。★ 兩個過去動作比先後，先發生的用 had + 過去分詞。

questions.q: The maintenance crew ___ the elevators every three months.
questions.note: every three months 是頻率 → 現在簡單式。★ every／usually／always 這類頻率詞配現在簡單式。

questions.q: Since the software update was installed, the number of support calls ___ noticeably.
questions.note: Since + 過去時間點 → 主句用現在完成式。★ Since 幾乎是現在完成式的專屬信號。

questions.q: The keynote speaker ___ at the conference center when the power outage occurred.
questions.note: when + 過去式短動作，背景用過去進行式。★ 一個動作打斷另一個，被打斷的那個用進行式。

questions.q: Please note that the cafeteria ___ for renovation from May 3 through May 17.
questions.note: from May 3 through May 17 是未來期間 → 未來式被動。★ 通知類題目常考未來安排。

questions.q: Our regional office in Osaka ___ its sales target for three consecutive quarters.
questions.note: for three consecutive quarters 表示持續到現在 → 現在完成式。★ for + 一段時間，答案通常是完成式。

questions.q: The shipment ___ the warehouse before the storm closed the highway.
questions.note: before + 過去式 → 更早的動作用過去完成式。★ 跟 p5-017 同一條規則，方向相反著考。

questions.q: If the vendor confirms the price today, we ___ the purchase order tomorrow morning.
questions.note: 條件句：if 子句用現在式，主句用未來式。★ if 後面已經是現在式，空格就是 will。

questions.q: Attendees ___ their badges at the registration desk before entering the exhibition hall.
questions.note: 規定用助動詞 must。★ 指示或規則類句子常考 must／should／may 的語意差別。

questions.q: The quarterly report ___ to all shareholders by the end of this week.
questions.note: report 不會自己發，是被發 → 被動。★ 主詞是「物」而動詞是「人才做得出來的動作」，就選被動。

questions.q: All applications ___ by a three-member review panel before final approval.
questions.note: by + 執行者是被動的明確信號。★ 看到 by someone，先往被動找。

questions.q: The new safety regulations ___ into effect on the first of next month.
questions.note: go into effect 是不及物片語，沒有被動。★ 陷阱：看到規定就反射選被動，但 go into effect 本身就是主動用法。

questions.q: Employees who ___ for the wellness program will receive a confirmation email.
questions.note: register for 是主動：人自己去報名。★ 關係代名詞 who 後面要動詞，主詞是 Employees。

questions.q: The conference room ___ for the entire afternoon, so please use the smaller meeting space.
questions.note: 房間是被預訂的 → 現在完成被動。★ 主詞是地點或物品時，動詞多半是被動。

questions.q: Customers ___ that delivery times may be longer during the holiday season.
questions.note: customers are advised that... 是公告的固定講法。★ 這類「顧客被告知」的句型在 Part 6 通知裡出現率極高。

questions.q: The technical issue ___ within two hours of being reported.
questions.note: issue 是被解決的 → 過去被動。★ within two hours 指出已完成，用過去式。

questions.q: The workshop will be held ___ the third floor of the east building.
questions.note: 樓層用 on。★ on the third floor、in the building、at the desk —— 三個層級要分清楚。

questions.q: All expense reports must be submitted ___ the fifth of each month.
questions.note: by = 在…之前完成（期限）。★ 陷阱：until 是「持續到」，跟 submit 這種瞬間動作不搭。

questions.q: The store will remain open ___ nine o'clock on weekends.
questions.note: remain 是持續狀態 → until。★ 跟上一題正好對照：持續動詞配 until，完成動詞配 by。

questions.q: The renovation project was completed ___ schedule despite the material shortage.
questions.note: ahead of schedule = 提前完工，固定片語。★ in front of 是空間上的前面，不能用在時程。

questions.q: Please refer ___ the attached document for the full list of specifications.
questions.note: refer to 是固定搭配。★ 動詞＋介系詞的組合要整組背，沒有道理可推。

questions.q: The company has operated in this market ___ more than two decades.
questions.note: for + 一段時間，since + 時間點。★ more than two decades 是長度不是點，所以用 for。

questions.q: Registration must be completed ___ forty-eight hours of receiving the invitation.
questions.note: within + 時間長度 = 在…之內。★ 陷阱：in forty-eight hours 是「四十八小時後」，意思相反。

questions.q: The award was presented ___ recognition of her twenty years of service.
questions.note: in recognition of = 為表彰，固定片語。★ 這類 in + 名詞 + of 的片語在頒獎與公告文中很常見。

questions.q: Passengers should proceed ___ Gate 14 immediately after the announcement.
questions.note: proceed to = 前往。★ 方向用 to，位置用 at。

questions.q: The revised policy applies ___ all employees hired after January 1.
questions.note: apply to = 適用於。★ 注意 apply for 是「申請」，意思完全不同。

questions.q: The seminar has been postponed ___ further notice.
questions.note: until further notice = 另行通知前，固定片語。★ 公告類最常見的收尾句之一。

questions.q: The laboratory is accessible only ___ authorized personnel.
questions.note: accessible to = 對…開放。★ 形容詞後面固定搭配哪個介系詞，也要整組記。

questions.q: ___ the shipment arrived late, the client agreed to keep the original payment terms.
questions.note: 後面接完整子句要用連接詞 Although。★ 陷阱：Despite 是介系詞，後面只能接名詞或動名詞。

questions.q: ___ the heavy rain, the outdoor event proceeded as planned.
questions.note: 後面是名詞片語 the heavy rain → 用介系詞 Despite。★ 跟上一題成對，判斷關鍵只有「後面是子句還是名詞」。

questions.q: The proposal was rejected ___ it exceeded the approved budget.
questions.note: 後面是完整子句 → because。★ because of 與 due to 後面只能接名詞。

questions.q: Sales improved in the third quarter; ___, the annual target was still not met.
questions.note: 分號後面接副詞 however 加逗號。★ however 是副詞不是連接詞，不能直接連兩個子句。

questions.q: Employees may work remotely ___ they notify their supervisor in advance.
questions.note: as long as = 只要（條件），後面接子句。★ in case of 後面接名詞。

questions.q: The vendor will either replace the defective units ___ issue a full refund.
questions.note: either A or B 是固定成對。★ 看到 either 就找 or，看到 neither 就找 nor。

questions.q: ___ the manager nor the assistant was available to sign the document.
questions.note: Neither A nor B。★ 動詞 was 是單數，也符合 neither...nor 就近一致的規則。

questions.q: Please submit the form ___ you have gathered all the supporting documents.
questions.note: once = 一旦…就，後面接子句。★ during 是介系詞，in order to 後面接原形動詞。

questions.q: The technician ___ repaired the printer will return on Friday for a follow-up check.
questions.note: 先行詞是人且在子句中當主詞 → who。★ 陷阱：whom 只能當受詞，這裡後面直接接動詞。

questions.q: The building ___ our new office is located was completed last year.
questions.note: be located in → 介系詞提前變 in which。★ 空格後面是完整句子，表示關係代名詞不當主詞或受詞。

questions.q: We are looking for candidates ___ experience includes international logistics.
questions.note: whose = 所有格關係代名詞。★ 空格後面直接接名詞 experience，就是 whose。

questions.q: The report highlighted several issues, most of ___ had already been addressed.
questions.note: 介系詞 of 後面要用關係代名詞 which。★ 陷阱：most of them 會變成兩個獨立句子硬接在一起。

questions.q: Each department must submit ___ own budget proposal by the deadline.
questions.note: Each department 是單數 → its。★ 陷阱：中文思維會想用 their，但 each 一律當單數。

questions.q: The director asked the interns to introduce ___ at the beginning of the session.
questions.note: 介紹自己 → 反身代名詞。★ 受詞跟主詞是同一群人時用 -selves。

questions.q: Neither of the two proposals ___ the committee's requirements.
questions.note: Neither of 當單數 → meets。★ of 後面的複數名詞是陷阱，真正的主詞是 Neither。

questions.q: ___ interested in the leadership program should contact the HR office.
questions.note: Those (who are) interested = 有興趣的人。★ 這是省略關係子句的固定用法。

questions.q: The two branches reported similar results, although ___ had a slightly higher profit margin.
questions.note: 兩者中的後者 = the latter。★ 前者是 the former，只用於兩個項目。

questions.q: If you need additional supplies, please let ___ know before Wednesday.
questions.note: let 後面接受格。★ 動詞或介系詞後面一律用受格。

questions.q: This year's turnout was ___ than we had anticipated.
questions.note: than 前面要比較級，far 可以修飾比較級。★ 陷阱：very 不能修飾比較級，much／far／considerably 才可以。

questions.q: Of all the applicants, Ms. Rivera had the ___ relevant experience.
questions.note: Of all + the → 最高級。★ 三者以上比較用 the most。

questions.q: The new packaging is not ___ durable as the previous design.
questions.note: not as + 形容詞 + as = 不如。★ 兩個 as 中間只能放原級。

questions.q: The sooner the invoice is approved, ___ the payment will be processed.
questions.note: The + 比較級, the + 比較級 = 越…越…。★ 前半已出現 The sooner，後半必須對稱。

questions.q: Attendance this year was roughly ___ as last year's.
questions.note: 倍數 + as + 原級 + as。★ 倍數詞永遠放在第一個 as 前面。

questions.q: Among the three candidates, Mr. Haddad is by far the ___ qualified.
questions.note: Among the three → 最高級，by far 加強最高級。★ by far 也可以修飾比較級，但這裡有 the，只能是最高級。

questions.q: The committee decided ___ the vote until all members were present.
questions.note: decide 後面接不定詞。★ decide／agree／plan／hope 都接 to + 原形。

questions.q: We recommend ___ the manual before operating the equipment.
questions.note: recommend 後面接動名詞。★ recommend／suggest／consider／avoid／enjoy 都接 -ing。

questions.q: The manager asked the team ___ the presentation slides by noon.
questions.note: ask + 受詞 + to 原形。★ tell／advise／remind／encourage 也是同一個句型。

questions.q: ___ from the airport, the delegation went directly to the hotel.
questions.note: 分詞構句：主詞主動做的動作用現在分詞。★ 代表團自己抵達，所以是 Arriving。

questions.q: ___ in a hurry, the report contained several formatting errors.
questions.note: 報告是被寫的 → 過去分詞。★ 跟上一題成對：主動用 -ing，被動用 -ed。

questions.q: The department is responsible for ___ that all equipment meets safety standards.
questions.note: 介系詞 for 後面接動名詞。★ 任何介系詞後面的動詞都要變 -ing。

questions.q: Staff members are reminded ___ their identification badges at all times.
questions.note: be reminded to 原形。★ remind 的被動式後面一樣接不定詞。

questions.q: The two companies have agreed to ___ a joint venture in Southeast Asia.
questions.note: establish a joint venture 是固定搭配。★ construct／build 用於實體建築，assemble 是組裝零件。

questions.q: Please ___ the attached invoice and confirm the total amount.
questions.note: review a document = 審閱文件。★ watch 是看動態畫面，observe 偏觀察現象。

questions.q: The airline offers a full ___ if the flight is cancelled by the carrier.
questions.note: a full refund 是固定說法。★ return 是退貨（東西），refund 是退款（錢）。

questions.q: Our team will ___ the survey results at next week's meeting.
questions.note: present results = 報告結果。★ introduce 是介紹人或新事物，語意不同。

questions.q: All maintenance requests should be ___ through the online portal.
questions.note: submit a request = 提出申請。★ 這是公告文的高頻動詞，Part 6 也常考。

questions.q: The company plans to ___ its distribution network into three new provinces.
questions.note: expand a network 是固定搭配。★ enlarge 偏放大尺寸，increase 偏增加數量。

questions.q: Applicants must ___ the minimum qualifications listed in the job posting.
questions.note: meet the qualifications／requirements = 符合條件。★ 這個 meet 跟「見面」無關，是多益高頻用法。

questions.q: The manufacturer has issued a ___ for all units produced before March.
questions.note: issue a recall = 發布召回。★ 產品瑕疵的固定說法。

questions.q: We appreciate your ___ while the system is being upgraded.
questions.note: your + 名詞。★ patience 是不可數名詞（耐心），patients 是病人，拼字近但意思差很遠。

questions.q: The contract will automatically ___ unless either party gives thirty days' notice.
questions.note: renew a contract = 續約。★ unless 那半句是「除非…否則」，語意上要能接自動延續。

questions.q: Ms. Bergman was ___ to vice president of operations last month.
questions.note: be promoted to = 升職為。★ raise 用於薪水，upgrade 用於系統或設備。

questions.q: The store will ___ its regular hours starting next Monday.
questions.note: resume = 恢復（中斷後繼續）。★ restore 是修復原狀，return 後面要加 to。

questions.q: Please make sure the meeting room is ___ before you leave.
questions.note: be 動詞後面接形容詞。★ tidy 本身就是形容詞，不需要再變化。

questions.q: The firm has a strong ___ for delivering projects on time.
questions.note: a strong ___ for 是「冠詞＋形容詞＋名詞」。★ have a reputation for = 以…著稱。

questions.q: All prices are subject ___ change without prior notice.
questions.note: be subject to = 可能有所變動，固定片語。★ 價目表與合約的高頻句尾。

questions.q: The board expressed strong ___ for the expansion plan.
questions.note: 形容詞 strong 後面要名詞。★ 冠詞或形容詞後面的空格，先往名詞找。

questions.q: The new hires completed the orientation ___ within the first week.
questions.note: 修飾動詞 completed 要副詞。★ 句子已完整，拿掉也通順的就是副詞。

questions.q: Please provide a ___ description of the problem so we can assist you.
questions.note: 冠詞 a 與名詞 description 之間要形容詞。

questions.q: The ___ of the new branch has been delayed until September.
questions.note: The ___ of 結構要名詞。★ opening 在這裡是動名詞轉名詞（開幕）。

questions.q: Our customer service team responds to inquiries ___ and courteously.
questions.note: and 後面是副詞 courteously，前面要對稱。★ 對稱結構是最快的判斷法。

questions.q: The manager requested a ___ review of the department's spending.
questions.note: a ___ review 中間要形容詞。★ 陷阱：through 是介系詞，跟 thorough 只差一個字母。

questions.q: Attendance has grown ___ since the workshop series began.
questions.note: 修飾動詞 has grown 要副詞。

questions.q: The firm is known for the ___ of its financial reporting.
questions.note: the ___ of 要名詞。★ accuracy 是標準名詞形，accurateness 不是常用字。

questions.q: All equipment must be handled with ___ care during transport.
questions.note: 名詞 care 前面要形容詞。★ with + 形容詞 + 名詞 是常見結構。

questions.q: The ___ between the two departments has improved considerably.
questions.note: The ___ between 要名詞。

questions.q: Ms. Ferreira is ___ qualified for the position of regional director.
questions.note: 修飾形容詞 qualified 要副詞。★ highly qualified 是固定搭配，不能用 high。

questions.q: The report offers a ___ analysis of consumer trends in the region.
questions.note: a ___ analysis 中間要形容詞。

questions.q: Employees should keep their contact information ___ at all times.
questions.note: keep + 受詞 + 形容詞。★ 陷阱：currently 是副詞，不能當受詞補語。

questions.q: The company has made a significant ___ in renewable energy.
questions.note: a significant ___ 要名詞。

questions.q: The instructions were written ___ so that anyone could follow them.
questions.note: 修飾過去分詞 written 要副詞。

questions.q: There has been a noticeable ___ in customer complaints this quarter.
questions.note: a noticeable ___ in 要名詞。

questions.q: The proposal was ___ received by everyone at the meeting.
questions.note: 修飾動詞 received 要副詞。

questions.q: Safety training is a ___ part of every new employee's first month.
questions.note: a ___ part 中間要形容詞，required 當形容詞用。

questions.q: The delivery truck ___ at the loading dock when the alarm sounded.
questions.note: when + 過去式短動作，背景用過去進行式。

questions.q: By next December, Mr. Sarr ___ with the company for a decade.
questions.note: By + 未來時間 → 未來完成式。

questions.q: The technician ___ the machine twice before it finally started.
questions.note: before + 過去式 → 更早的動作用過去完成式。

questions.q: Our office ___ recycling bins on every floor since last spring.
questions.note: since + 過去時間點 → 現在完成式。

questions.q: The catering staff ___ the banquet hall at six tomorrow evening.
questions.note: 未來某時刻正在進行 → 未來進行式。★ at six tomorrow 是未來的時間點。

questions.q: Ms. Cortez ___ three international projects during her time in Berlin.
questions.note: during her time in Berlin 指已結束的過去期間 → 過去式。

questions.q: The system ___ automatically every night at midnight.
questions.note: every night 是習慣 → 現在簡單式。

questions.q: We ___ the contract as soon as the legal team approves the final draft.
questions.note: as soon as 子句用現在式，主句用未來式。★ 時間副詞子句不用未來式，這是常考點。

questions.q: Prices for raw materials ___ steadily over the past eighteen months.
questions.note: over the past + 期間 → 現在完成式。

questions.q: Before the software was upgraded, staff ___ to enter the data manually.
questions.note: Before + 過去式 → 主句用過去完成式。★ had to 的完成式是 had had to。

questions.q: The museum ___ its doors at five o'clock on weekdays.
questions.note: 營業時間是常態 → 現在簡單式。

questions.q: The award ceremony ___ in the main auditorium next Friday.
questions.note: 典禮是被舉辦的 → 未來被動。

questions.q: Visitors ___ to sign in at the front desk upon arrival.
questions.note: 訪客是被要求的 → 被動。

questions.q: The damaged shipment ___ to the supplier last Tuesday.
questions.note: 貨物是被退回的 → 過去被動。

questions.q: The renovation ___ three months longer than originally estimated.
questions.note: take + 時間是主動用法，沒有被動。★ 陷阱：看到「被估計」就想選被動。

questions.q: All personal data ___ on encrypted servers located within the country.
questions.note: 資料是被儲存的 → 被動。

questions.q: The new policy ___ effect immediately after the announcement.
questions.note: take effect 是固定片語，主動用法。

questions.q: Participants ___ a certificate upon completing all four modules.
questions.note: 人是接受方，用主動 receive。★ 陷阱：中文說「被頒發」，但英文主詞是人時用 receive。

questions.q: The training manual is available ___ request from the HR department.
questions.note: upon request = 應要求提供，固定片語。

questions.q: Sales in the Asian market grew by twelve percent ___ the third quarter.
questions.note: during + 名詞期間。★ 陷阱：while 是連接詞，後面要接子句。

questions.q: The parcel should arrive ___ three business days.
questions.note: within + 時間長度 = 在…之內。

questions.q: Employees are eligible for the bonus ___ completing one full year of service.
questions.note: after + 動名詞。★ since 後面接動名詞不合語意，during 後面不接動名詞。

questions.q: The conference will be held ___ the Grand Hotel in Vancouver.
questions.note: 特定地點用 at。★ at the hotel（點）、in Vancouver（大範圍）。

questions.q: This coupon is valid ___ purchases over fifty dollars only.
questions.note: valid on purchases = 適用於…消費。

questions.q: The department is currently short ___ qualified technicians.
questions.note: be short of = 缺少，固定搭配。

questions.q: Please keep the receipt ___ case you need to exchange the item.
questions.note: in case = 以防萬一，固定片語。

questions.q: The revised figures are consistent ___ last year's audit results.
questions.note: be consistent with = 與…一致。

questions.q: The seminar is open to anyone ___ prior experience in the field.
questions.note: with = 具有。★ anyone with experience 是常見結構。

questions.q: Deliveries are suspended ___ the duration of the road closure.
questions.note: for the duration of = 在…期間內，固定說法。

questions.q: The manager is responsible ___ approving all travel expenses.
questions.note: be responsible for = 負責。★ 注意 responsible to someone 是「對某人負責」，語意不同。

questions.q: ___ the equipment arrives, the installation team will begin work.
questions.note: Once 是連接詞，後面接子句。★ 另外三個都是介系詞。

questions.q: The office will remain open ___ the renovation is completed.
questions.note: until 當連接詞，後面接子句。

questions.q: ___ sales increased, overall profit declined because of higher costs.
questions.note: 後面接子句 → 用連接詞 Although。

questions.q: Not only ___ the deadline, but the team also stayed under budget.
questions.note: Not only 放句首要倒裝。★ 這是 Part 5 難度較高的一題，看到句首 Not only 就找助動詞倒裝。

questions.q: The vendor offers free shipping ___ the order exceeds one hundred dollars.
questions.note: provided that = 只要，連接詞，後面接子句。

questions.q: The flight was delayed; ___, all passengers were rebooked within the hour.
questions.note: 分號後接副詞 nevertheless。★ 跟 however 同一類，是副詞不是連接詞。

questions.q: ___ you have any questions, please contact the support line.
questions.note: Should 放句首 = If you should，正式書信的倒裝條件句。

questions.q: The company relocated its warehouse ___ reduce transportation costs.
questions.note: in order to + 原形動詞。★ so that 後面要接完整子句。

questions.q: Sales rose in the north, ___ the southern region saw a slight decline.
questions.note: whereas = 然而（對比），連接兩個子句。

questions.q: The system will shut down automatically ___ it detects unusual activity.
questions.note: if 是連接詞，後面接子句。

questions.q: ___ hiring more staff, the company invested in automation software.
questions.note: Rather than + 動名詞 = 而不是。★ 其餘三個是連接詞，後面要接子句。

questions.q: The vendor ___ we contacted last month has updated its pricing.
questions.note: 先行詞是人且在子句中當受詞 → whom。★ 空格後面是主詞 we，表示關係代名詞不當主詞。

questions.q: The office ___ was renovated last year now houses the design team.
questions.note: 先行詞是物且在子句中當主詞 → that／which。★ where 後面要接完整句子。

questions.q: We visited the factory ___ the components are assembled.
questions.note: 空格後是完整句子且先行詞是地點 → where。

questions.q: The consultant recommended a strategy ___ results were immediate.
questions.note: whose 也可以用在物：strategy 的 results。★ 空格後直接接名詞就是 whose。

questions.q: ___ the committee decides will be announced on Monday.
questions.note: Whatever = 無論什麼，本身帶先行詞，可當主詞。

questions.q: The year ___ the company was founded is printed on every product label.
questions.note: be founded in a year → 介系詞提前變 in which。

questions.q: The two managers divided the workload between ___.
questions.note: 主詞與受詞是同一群人 → 反身代名詞。

questions.q: If any of the invoices are incorrect, please return ___ to accounting.
questions.note: invoices 是複數 → them。

questions.q: ___ of the applicants has been notified of the interview schedule.
questions.note: 動詞 has 是單數 → Each。★ 其餘三個都要配複數動詞。

questions.q: The team completed the project ___ without outside assistance.
questions.note: team 當單一整體 → itself。★ themself 不是標準用法。

questions.q: This printer is faster than ___ in the other office.
questions.note: 單數可數名詞的替代用 the one。

questions.q: Very ___ of the attendees left before the closing remarks.
questions.note: attendees 是可數複數 → few。★ little 用於不可數。

questions.q: The updated model is considerably ___ to operate than the previous one.
questions.note: than 前面要比較級形容詞。★ 陷阱：more easily 是副詞比較級，這裡需要形容詞。

questions.q: Of the four proposals, this one requires the ___ amount of funding.
questions.note: Of the four → 最高級；amount 是不可數 → least。

questions.q: The second workshop attracted ___ participants than the first.
questions.note: far 可以修飾比較級 more。★ very 不能修飾比較級。

questions.q: Our response time is now half ___ it was two years ago.
questions.note: half what it was = 只有以前的一半。★ what 帶出名詞子句。

questions.q: This is by far the ___ efficient layout we have tested.
questions.note: the + 最高級，by far 加強語氣。

questions.q: The sooner we finalize the design, ___ risk of delay we face.
questions.note: The + 比較級, the + 比較級。★ risk 不可數，用 less。

questions.q: The committee postponed ___ a decision until the report was complete.
questions.note: postpone 後面接動名詞。★ postpone／delay／finish／avoid 都接 -ing。

questions.q: We look forward to ___ from you at your earliest convenience.
questions.note: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接動名詞。★ 這是最經典的陷阱之一。

questions.q: The supervisor allowed the team ___ the deadline by two days.
questions.note: allow + 受詞 + to 原形。

questions.q: ___ properly maintained, the machinery can last over twenty years.
questions.note: If (it is) properly maintained，省略了主詞與 be 動詞。

questions.q: The manual is worth ___ before you operate the equipment.
questions.note: be worth + 動名詞，且用主動形表被動意。

questions.q: Staff members are required ___ their timesheets by Friday afternoon.
questions.note: be required to 原形。

questions.q: ___ the presentation, Ms. Aluko answered questions for twenty minutes.
questions.note: 完成式分詞表示先後：先講完才回答問題。

questions.q: The company avoided ___ additional staff by automating the process.
questions.note: avoid 後面接動名詞。

questions.q: The purpose of this memo is ___ everyone of the new parking rules.
questions.note: be 動詞後面接不定詞當主詞補語。

questions.q: We regret ___ you that the position has already been filled.
questions.note: regret to inform = 遺憾地通知（要做的事）。★ regret informing 是「後悔已通知」，語意相反。

questions.q: The supplier failed to ___ the terms of the agreement.
questions.note: comply with = 遵守。

questions.q: Please ___ the enclosed brochure for a full list of services.
questions.note: consult a brochure／manual = 查閱。

questions.q: The airline will ___ passengers for any additional baggage fees.
questions.note: reimburse + 人 = 補償某人。★ refund + 錢，reimburse + 人，受詞不同。

questions.q: All employees must ___ to the company's confidentiality policy.
questions.note: adhere to = 遵守（政策、規範）。

questions.q: The manager will ___ the responsibilities among the three teams.
questions.note: distribute = 分配。★ deliver 是遞送實體物品。

questions.q: Sales representatives are expected to ___ their monthly quotas.
questions.note: fulfill a quota = 達成配額。

questions.q: The department will ___ a survey to measure employee satisfaction.
questions.note: conduct a survey = 進行調查，高頻搭配。

questions.q: Any changes to the schedule will be posted on the ___ board.
questions.note: bulletin board = 公布欄。★ billboard 是戶外大型廣告看板。

questions.q: The warranty does not ___ damage caused by improper use.
questions.note: a warranty covers something = 保固涵蓋。

questions.q: Our records ___ that your subscription expired last month.
questions.note: records indicate that = 紀錄顯示。

questions.q: The firm has decided to ___ its headquarters to a larger building.
questions.note: relocate = 遷移。★ replace 是取代，remove 是移除。

questions.q: Attendance is limited, so early ___ is strongly recommended.
questions.note: early registration = 提早報名，形容詞後接名詞。

questions.q: The technician will ___ the equipment before the inspection.
questions.note: calibrate equipment = 校準設備。★ 四個字拼法接近，是典型的詞彙陷阱。

questions.q: Please ___ your seat belt while the aircraft is taxiing.
questions.note: fasten a seat belt 是固定說法。

questions.q: The new regulation will ___ businesses with fewer than ten employees.
questions.note: exempt = 豁免。★ except 是介系詞，不能直接當及物動詞用。

questions.q: We appreciate your ___ in helping us test the new system.
questions.note: your + 名詞。★ participant 是「參與者」（人），這裡要的是「參與」這件事。

questions.q: The contract clearly ___ the responsibilities of both parties.
questions.note: specify = 明確規定。

questions.q: Overtime pay is calculated ___ an hourly basis.
questions.note: on a ... basis = 以…為基礎，固定片語。

questions.q: The retailer offers a thirty-day ___ period for all electronics.
questions.note: return period = 退貨期，名詞當形容詞用。

questions.q: Applicants should ___ a cover letter along with their résumé.
questions.note: enclose = 隨函附上，書信高頻字。

questions.q: The factory operates at full ___ during the holiday season.
questions.note: at full capacity = 滿載運轉。★ capability 是能力，不用於產能。

questions.q: Management is ___ of the delays and is working on a solution.
questions.note: be aware of = 知悉。

questions.q: The invoice must be paid ___ full within thirty days of receipt.
questions.note: pay in full = 全額付清，固定片語。

passage: NOTICE TO ALL EMPLOYEES
The east parking lot ___(1)___ from Monday, April 8, through Friday, April 19, while the surface is repaved. During this period, please use the visitor lot on Chestnut Street.
___(2)___ the visitor lot has fewer spaces than usual, we encourage staff to carpool or take public transit whenever possible.
___(3)___ Employees who normally hold reserved spaces will be assigned temporary ones by the facilities office.
We ___(4)___ your patience during the work. Questions may be directed to facilities@brightonlogistics.com.

questions.q: 空格 (1)
questions.note: from April 8 through April 19 是未來期間，停車場是被關閉的 → 未來式被動。

questions.q: 空格 (2)
questions.note: 後面接完整子句且是原因 → 連接詞 Because。★ Despite 是介系詞，However 與 Therefore 是副詞，都不能直接連子句。

questions.q: 空格 (3)　選出最適合放這裡的句子
choices: All company vehicles were serviced earlier this year.
Parking fees will increase beginning in January.
Shuttle service will run every fifteen minutes between the visitor lot and the main entrance.
The cafeteria will introduce a new seasonal menu next month.
questions.note: 插入句題。★ 前後都在談停車與交通，只有接駁車那句接得上。其餘三句主題正確但跟這段的邏輯無關 —— 這正是插入句題最常見的陷阱：看起來像公司公告，但接不上前後文。

questions.q: 空格 (4)
questions.note: We ___ your patience 需要動詞。★ appreciate your patience 是公告收尾的固定說法。

passage: Dear Ms. Halvorsen,
Thank you for your order placed on March 3. I am writing to let you know that two items in your order are currently ___(1)___ and will not ship with the rest of your shipment.
___(2)___ we expect the remaining items to arrive at our warehouse by March 20, we can send the available items immediately at no additional shipping cost.
Please reply to this message to let us know which option you ___(3)___. ___(4)___
Sincerely,
Devon Achebe, Customer Service

questions.q: 空格 (1)
questions.note: 商品缺貨 = out of stock。★ out of order 是機器故障，out of date 是過期，三個片語長得像但用途完全不同。

questions.q: 空格 (2)
questions.note: Since = 既然（原因），後面接子句。★ 語意上「既然預計 3/20 到貨，我們可以先寄已備妥的」。

questions.q: 空格 (3)
questions.note: 主詞是 you → 原形 prefer。

questions.q: 空格 (4)　選出最適合放這裡的句子
choices: We have recently updated the design of our packaging.
Our retail location on Fifth Avenue is open until eight in the evening.
Please note that the warranty period begins on the date of purchase.
If we do not hear from you by March 10, we will hold the entire order until all items are available.
questions.note: 插入句題。★ 前一句要對方回覆，接下來合理的是「沒回覆會怎樣」。其餘三句都是通用的客服語句，跟這封信的處理流程無關。

passage: SUMMIT FITNESS — NOW OPEN ON RIVERSIDE DRIVE
Our newest location offers more than eighty pieces of equipment, four studio rooms, and a heated pool. Members enjoy ___(1)___ access to all six of our city branches at no extra charge.
Join before May 31 and your first month is free. ___(2)___
Not sure yet? Stop by for a free trial session. Our staff will design a program ___(3)___ to your goals and current fitness level.
Visit summitfitness.example or call the front desk to ___(4)___ an appointment.

questions.q: 空格 (1)
questions.note: 名詞 access 前面要形容詞。★ unlimited access 是固定搭配。

questions.q: 空格 (2)　選出最適合放這裡的句子
choices: Our corporate office relocated to Denver last year.
Parking on Riverside Drive is limited to two hours.
No enrollment fee is required, and the offer applies to both individual and family plans.
The building was originally constructed as a textile factory.
questions.note: 插入句題。★ 前一句在講優惠，接著補充優惠細節最順。歷史沿革與辦公室搬遷跟促銷無關。

questions.q: 空格 (3)
questions.note: program 是被量身設計的 → 過去分詞 tailored。★ tailored to = 針對…量身打造。

questions.q: 空格 (4)
questions.note: to + 原形動詞。

passage: MEMO
To: All Department Heads
From: IT Operations
Beginning next Monday, all expense reports must be submitted through the new online portal. The paper form ___(1)___ accepted after June 1.
Training sessions will be held on Wednesday and Thursday at ten in the morning. Attendance is not mandatory, ___(2)___ we strongly recommend it for anyone who processes reports regularly.
___(3)___ If you encounter difficulty logging in, contact the help desk at extension 4400.
We expect the transition to ___(4)___ processing time by roughly three days per report.

questions.q: 空格 (1)
questions.note: after June 1 是未來 → 未來式被動。★ 紙本表格是被接受的一方。

questions.q: 空格 (2)
questions.note: 前後是轉折（不強制 vs 強烈建議）→ but。★ therefore 是副詞，不能連接兩個子句。

questions.q: 空格 (3)　選出最適合放這裡的句子
choices: Our annual charity drive raised over twelve thousand dollars.
The cafeteria will close early on the last Friday of every month.
Login credentials will be emailed to each department head by Friday afternoon.
Printer toner should be ordered through the supplies request form.
questions.note: 插入句題。★ 後一句講「登入有困難就找 help desk」，前面必須先提到登入帳密。這題的線索在後面不在前面 —— 插入句要前後都讀。

questions.q: 空格 (4)
questions.note: expect + 受詞 + to + 原形動詞。

passage: Dear Mr. Vasquez,
Thank you for applying for the position of logistics coordinator at Northgate Freight. After reviewing your application, we ___(1)___ to invite you to an interview.
The interview will take place on Tuesday, September 12, at two in the afternoon in our Oakwood office. Please allow approximately ninety minutes. ___(2)___
Kindly confirm your ___(3)___ by replying to this email no later than Friday.
If the proposed time is not convenient, please suggest two alternative slots and we ___(4)___ our best to accommodate you.
Best regards,
Priya Raghunathan, Human Resources

questions.q: 空格 (1)
questions.note: would like to = 想要，正式書信的禮貌說法。

questions.q: 空格 (2)　選出最適合放這裡的句子
choices: Free parking is available at all of our warehouse locations.
The position was advertised in several regional newspapers.
You will meet with the department manager and two members of the operations team.
Our company was founded more than forty years ago.
questions.note: 插入句題。★ 前一句說「請預留九十分鐘」，接著說明這段時間要做什麼最合理。公司歷史與刊登管道都不解釋為什麼要九十分鐘。

questions.q: 空格 (3)
questions.note: your + 名詞。★ attendant 是「服務員」（人），意思完全不同。

questions.q: 空格 (4)
questions.note: 條件句：if 子句用現在式（is not），主句用未來式。

passage: IMPORTANT SAFETY NOTICE
Larkfield Appliances is ___(1)___ a voluntary recall of the model KT-220 electric kettle manufactured between January and March of this year.
In a small number of units, the automatic shut-off may fail to activate. ___(2)___ no injuries have been reported, we are asking all owners to stop using the product immediately.
To determine ___(3)___ your kettle is affected, locate the serial number on the base of the unit and enter it at larkfield.example/recall.
___(4)___ Customers will receive either a replacement unit or a full refund, whichever they prefer.

questions.q: 空格 (1)
questions.note: is + 現在分詞 = 現在進行式。

questions.q: 空格 (2)
questions.note: 轉折：雖然沒有傷亡通報，但仍請停用。★ Because 與 Since 都是原因，語意接不上。

questions.q: 空格 (3)
questions.note: determine whether = 判斷是否。★ 陷阱：if 雖然也能表「是否」，但 if it is 加了多餘的主詞與動詞。

questions.q: 空格 (4)　選出最適合放這裡的句子
choices: The company expanded its product line to include coffee grinders in 2019.
Our customer service hours are Monday through Friday.
Affected kettles may be returned to any retail location or shipped to us using a prepaid label.
Recycling programs are available in most municipalities.
questions.note: 插入句題。★ 後一句講「顧客會拿到替換品或退款」，前面必須先講怎麼把東西退回來。★ 召回通知的邏輯順序是：問題→確認是否受影響→怎麼退→退了會得到什麼。

passage: BREAK ROOM COFFEE MACHINE — QUICK GUIDE
Before brewing, make sure the water tank is filled to the line marked MAX. The machine ___(1)___ if the tank is empty.
Place a filter in the basket and add one scoop of grounds ___(2)___ cup. Close the lid firmly until it clicks.
Press the green button once. The indicator light will blink ___(3)___ brewing and turn solid when the pot is ready.
___(4)___ Please rinse the carafe before returning it to the warming plate.

questions.q: 空格 (1)
questions.note: 條件下的必然結果 → 未來式。★ 說明書描述的是「如果…就會…」。

questions.q: 空格 (2)
questions.note: per cup = 每一杯。★ one scoop per cup 是說明書的標準寫法。

questions.q: 空格 (3)
questions.note: during + 名詞 brewing。★ 陷阱：while 是連接詞，後面要接子句。

questions.q: 空格 (4)　選出最適合放這裡的句子
choices: Our supplier delivers fresh beans every other Tuesday.
The vending machine accepts both coins and cards.
Employees may store personal items in the lockers provided.
Turn the machine off if you take the last cup.
questions.note: 插入句題。★ 這一段是「用完之後」的收尾動作，接的是關機與沖洗壺。其餘三句都在休息室的範圍內，但不是操作步驟 —— 主題相關不等於邏輯接得上。

passage: Meridian Design Group will move its headquarters to the renovated Halstead Building in October, the firm announced on Tuesday.
The new space is nearly twice as large as the current office and ___(1)___ room for the company's growing engineering team.
"We had been looking for a location with better transit access for some time," said chief operating officer Ingrid Solberg. "___(2)___"
The Halstead Building, which ___(3)___ vacant since 2021, has been fitted with new heating and ventilation systems.
Meridian expects the relocation to be complete ___(4)___ the end of the year.

questions.q: 空格 (1)
questions.note: and 連接前面的 is，要對稱的動詞形式；搬遷在十月是未來 → will provide。

questions.q: 空格 (2)　選出最適合放這裡的句子
choices: Our design awards have doubled in the past three years.
We plan to release a new mobile application this winter.
The Halstead Building is a five-minute walk from two subway lines.
The firm currently employs about sixty people.
questions.note: 插入句題。★ 引號前一句說「一直在找交通更方便的地點」，引號裡自然要說明新地點交通如何方便。其餘三句都是公司的真實資訊，但沒有回應前一句。

questions.q: 空格 (3)
questions.note: since 2021 → 現在完成式。★ 到現在仍空置。

questions.q: 空格 (4)
questions.note: by the end of the year = 在年底前完成。★ complete 是完成動作，配 by 不配 until。
